content.short: Solidity Flattener provides a utility to flatten Solidity projects into a single file.
content.description: Solidity Flattener is a Gnosis Chain project that merges declared Solidity imports into a single flatten.sol file. This simplifies Solidity projects, making them easier to manage and scale by consolidating dependencies. The project is quick to install, available via npm or from a local file, and it achieves its aim efficiently. Its growing footprint on GitHub—an expanding number of repositories using the tool—attests to its usefulness.
